subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the remaining TUI work be docs/help for the current pi-tui behavior only, or should OpenClaw expose a supported configurable send/newline keybinding surface for openclaw tui?
rationale: Current main already supports newline insertion through pi-tui, but configurable send/newline behavior would add public TUI config or keybinding surface under a repo policy that sets a high bar for new config options.

options.title: Document Current Behavior
options.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Preference
options.body: Define a narrow supported keybinding/config surface with docs and tests for default and customized send/newline behavior.

options.title: Split Broader Composer Requests
options.body: Keep this issue focused on TUI inline behavior and leave WebChat shortcuts, external-editor handoff, and vi-mode to their separate trackers.

recommendation.title: Document Current Behavior
recommendation.body: Document Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest direct signal from prior review context and recent TUI wrapper/docs/keybinding-helper history.
